cards.title: Your Name
cards.text: Before your story begins, what are you called?

cards.title: Birth
cards.text: You are born under a grey sky.

cards.title: The Sea
cards.text: The sea gives and the sea takes.

cards.title: War
cards.text: You learn to hold a spear before a spoon.

cards.title: Lost at Sea
cards.text: Your story ends beneath the waves.

cards.title: Adulthood
cards.text: You come of age, ready for adventure.
